title: Global Stack Rank Configuration
description: Named profiles that select cross-org/cross-project/cross-provider work item sources and normalize each source's ranking field onto a single comparable 0-100 scale, producing one ordered virtual backlog.

providerKind.description: The provider family a source targets. AzureDevOps covers both Azure DevOps Services and Azure DevOps Server/TFS. GitHub covers both github.com and GitHub Enterprise.

direction.description: Whether a lower or higher raw ranking field value represents higher priority.

source.description: A single stable org/project (Azure DevOps) or owner/repository (GitHub) scope, optionally narrowed further, with its own ranking field normalization range.

name.description: Optional label for diagnostics and precedence-tie reporting.

host.description: Optional explicit host filter (e.g. ghe.mycompany.com), matched against the connection's base URL host.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization name, or GitHub owner/organization login.

project.description: Azure DevOps project name. Required for AzureDevOps sources; ignored for GitHub.

repository.description: GitHub repository name. Ignored for Azure DevOps. When omitted for GitHub, all repositories under the organization are eligible.

rankField.description: The field reference name that carries this source's ranking value (e.g. Microsoft.VSTS.Common.StackRank).

sourceMin.description: The minimum value of this source's raw ranking field range.

sourceMax.description: The maximum value of this source's raw ranking field range.

priority.description: Explicit precedence when multiple sources match the same work item; higher wins.

name.description: Unique identifier used to explicitly activate global ranking on a query.
